name: Valnerina
text: Valley of the Nera river in the Marches and Umbria, Italy.

depictions.name: Valnerina
depictions.text: The Valnerina is a valley in the Italian region of Umbria, which was formed by the river Nera in the mountains and is known for its winding roads and steep, narrow passes. As such, it is a particularly challenging landscape to navigate.
